## Summary

Describe the problem and the user-facing change.

## Validation

List commands run and outcomes.

## Release Checklist

- [ ] Changeset added (or `N/A` with reason)
- [ ] Tests added/updated for new behavior
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test`

## Documentation Checklist (required for user-facing changes)

- [ ] Reviewed `docs/documentation-release-checklist.md`
- [ ] Updated root discovery surfaces (`README.md`, docs overview/quickstart) where needed
- [ ] Updated integration docs where needed
- [ ] Updated package README(s) where needed
- [ ] Updated API reference/docs nav where needed
- [ ] Ran `pnpm docs:build`
- [ ] If docs changes are not required, included explicit rationale below

## Docs rationale (if skipped)

Explain why no documentation updates were required.
